verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's 'computer' ecosystem docs describe genuine exec capability: file browsing/editing, an Open Terminal for running Python/commands, tool-card approval workflows for file reads/edits (Allow/Deny), scheduled tasks that 'run the test suite' and report errors, and native support for coding-agent backends (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) operating in per-task worktrees/workspaces via a CLI (cptr run). This goes well beyond chat-only advice into real command execution and file mutation on the host. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the exec surface working reliably in practice (community evidence only discusses RAG/docker/licensing, not this feature).
